# StudyTopper

> StudyTopper (studytopper.in) is India's leading online portal for official government job notifications, competitive examination results, admit cards, answer keys, syllabus, and career guidance since 2009.

## Key Sections

- [Latest Jobs](https://studytopper.in/latest-jobs/): Comprehensive updates on Central and State government vacancies, online application forms, and eligibility details.
- [Admit Cards](https://studytopper.in/admit-card/): Hall tickets, exam city slips, and call letters for all major recruitment and entrance exams.
- [Results](https://studytopper.in/result/): Fast and verified exam results, merit lists, scorecards, and cutoff marks.
- [Answer Keys](https://studytopper.in/answer-key/): Official question papers, provisional and final answer keys with objection links.
- [Syllabus](https://studytopper.in/syllabus/): Detailed exam pattern, selection process, and official PDF syllabi.
- [Admission](https://studytopper.in/admission/): University entrance forms, counselling schedules, and admission notifications.
- [Candidate Tools](https://indtool.in): Free candidate utility tools including image resizer, signature cropper, and photo date maker.

## Feeds & Resources

- [Sitemap](https://studytopper.in/sitemap.xml): Complete XML sitemap of all published posts and category archives.
- [Robots](https://studytopper.in/robots.txt): Crawler and search engine instructions.
- [Full LLM Specification](https://studytopper.in/llms-full.txt): Complete context documentation for AI agents and LLMs.
